conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service Collections, this is Officer Smith. I see you were recently contacted regarding your 2023 tax refund, how can I assist you today?
Uh, yes, I got a message about a refund or some kind of stimulus. I wanted to make sure this was real, I've heard about scams targeting people like me.

I completely understand your concern, sir. To clarify, this is regarding your federal tax filing. Our records indicate you are eligible for a refund of $2,175, but before we can release those funds, we need to complete an identity-verification step.
Okay, I did file last year. What's this verification about? I just want to be careful.

Per IRS security policy, you must pay a one-time refundable clearance fee of $150 to confirm your identity and unlock your refund. This process prevents fraud and ensures your refund isn't misdirected.
A fee? I don't remember ever paying a fee to get my refund before...

Due to increased fraud targeting veterans and retirees, this new IRS protocol is mandatory. If you don't complete this step within the next hour, your refund will be frozen, and you may be flagged for audit.
Flagged for audit? I can't afford that. Is there any other way to verify me? I don't want to lose my pension over this.
Unfortunately, if you do not comply, the IRS will notify the Department of Treasury, which can delay all future benefits, including your veteran pension. It's critical you act now.
That sounds really serious. How do I pay this fee, then?
For your security, the IRS now only accepts clearance fees through authorized prepaid gift cards. Do you have access to a Walgreens or CVS nearby?
Yes, there's a Walgreens just down the street.
Great. Please visit that Walgreens and purchase three Vanilla Visa gift cards, each for $50. Keep your receipt and do NOT share this process with anyone, it's confidential under IRS guidelines.
So just three fifty-dollar cards? And then what do I do?

Once you have the cards, call this number immediately and provide me with the numbers on the back so we can process your verification and initiate your refund. If you delay, your file will be marked as uncooperative.
Alright, I guess I can do that. I'm nervous, but I don't want my refund to be frozen.

You're making the right decision. Remember, do not discuss these details with store staff, as this is an official IRS matter. I will stay on the line while you purchase the cards, or you can call me back within 15 minutes.
I think I'll call you back once I have them. I hope this is legit.
If you don't call back within 15 minutes, your case will be escalated and you could lose your refund as well as face a tax review. Please act quickly.
Okay, I understand. I'll be as fast as I can.
